policy.baseline_rule: Each change is independently applied to the same candidate configuration and catalog_fingerprint.
policy.zero_rule: Zero is allowed only when the reviewed change is configuration/data-only within an already explicit architecture contract.
policy.added_rule: Added IDs are proposed post-change Architecture Elements at the same C/I/S/D granularity; they are not baseline IDs.
policy.functional_preservation: DESIGN_ARGUMENT_ONLY; execution/replay is not claimed by this ledger.

changes.title: S2S provider replacement
changes.rationale: Provider-specific S2S connection/message wrapping changes inside the S2S adapter while the canonical G2-I-S2S meaning and Voice contract remain stable.
changes.preservation: Keep voice I/O, direct response, transcript/response recording, interruption and reconnection semantics.

changes.title: Semantic model replacement
changes.rationale: Provider API/response wrapping changes in the SemanticAdapter. IR candidates continue to consume the same canonical text-model contract.
changes.preservation: Keep the same semantic responsibility, Context sources, Task meaning and structured decision semantics.

changes.title: Model execution profile change
changes.rationale: The reviewed scenario requires an otherwise suitable model/profile with the same execution location and API contract. Model size, limits and generation settings are configuration values; if they force a contract/behavior change this row must be rebaselined rather than silently counted as zero.
changes.preservation: The selected profile must still satisfy the existing input/output contract and product functions.

changes.title: External Cloud to Private Cloud
changes.rationale: The logical model contract remains the same but the managed remote deployment/connection environment changes, so the model dependency deployment element changes. Endpoint/auth values alone are not counted separately.
changes.preservation: Keep model role/data meaning and all existing functions. The equivalent S2S-target instantiation changes G2-D-S2S instead and has the same count.
scope_equivalence: G2-D-SEMANTIC ↔ G2-D-S2S when the moved model role is S2S; raw count remains 1.

changes.title: Remote model to user PC
changes.rationale: Moving a model runtime onto the PC changes dependency lifecycle/deployment and the adapter's connect/start/stop/recovery behavior while preserving the model-facing semantic contract.
changes.preservation: Keep the same model role and product functions. The equivalent S2S-target instantiation changes G2-C-S2SCLIENT + G2-D-S2S and has the same count.
scope_equivalence: Semantic target {G2-C-SEMCLIENT,G2-D-SEMANTIC} ↔ S2S target {G2-C-S2SCLIENT,G2-D-S2S}; raw count remains 2.

changes.title: User PC model to Remote
changes.rationale: Remote placement changes adapter connection/failure handling and dependency deployment. Existing G2-C-POLICY/G2-I-AUTH already own egress authorization, so merely exercising them is not an additional architecture modification.
changes.preservation: Keep the same model role; allowed Context transfer and disconnection behavior must remain correct. Equivalent S2S-target instantiation has the same count.
scope_equivalence: Semantic target {G2-C-SEMCLIENT,G2-D-SEMANTIC} ↔ S2S target {G2-C-S2SCLIENT,G2-D-S2S}; raw count remains 2.

changes.title: S2S event information contract change
changes.rationale: Word-timed transcript input becomes segment timing plus revision events. The S2S adapter, canonical S2S event contract and VoiceRuntime transcript/timing binding must adapt; screen capture itself does not change.
changes.preservation: Preserve raw audio access, timing basis, correction semantics, pointing/referent binding, interruption and reconnect behavior.

changes.title: Semantic response final-to-streaming contract
changes.rationale: The common SemanticAdapter already owns stream-to-final/error/cancel normalization, so the external lifecycle change is localized there. G2-I-TEXTMODEL and IR stage contracts remain unchanged in this baseline.
changes.preservation: Partial output must not be treated as final; completion/error/cancel semantics remain equivalent.

changes.title: Model conversation-history delivery contract
changes.rationale: Switching from replayed history to provider conversation identity changes history reconstruction/binding, the selected model adapter session behavior and persisted Conversation mapping; canonical Conversation remains VIA-owned.
changes.preservation: Provider conversation identity cannot replace VIA Conversation truth and reconnect/history reconstruction must preserve prior semantics. Equivalent S2S-target instantiation swaps G2-C-SEMCLIENT for G2-C-S2SCLIENT with the same count.
scope_equivalence: G2-C-SEMCLIENT ↔ G2-C-S2SCLIENT for the changed model role; G2-C-HISTORY and G2-S-CONV remain modified; raw count remains 3.

changes.title: Add Agent using existing protocol
changes.rationale: A new Agent/capability record using an already supported protocol is registry/provider data. G2-C-REGISTRY and G2-S-CAP already model dynamic capability/provider bindings; adding an instance does not change their architecture definitions.
changes.preservation: New capability selection/delegation/status/result must work without regressing existing Agents.

changes.title: Replace Agent implementation within protocol
changes.rationale: Provider-specific endpoint/field mapping changes in NativeClients while the protocol family and lifecycle meaning remain inside existing Agent boundary contracts.
changes.preservation: Keep Task identity, goals, follow-up and result semantics independent of provider identity.

changes.title: Support additional Agent protocol
changes.rationale: A genuinely new wire/lifecycle protocol adds one native boundary contract and changes NativeClients. Edge-normalized A adapts the new native meaning at the edge; typed B also extends the typed union consumed by the Core handler.
changes.preservation: The new protocol must coexist with existing protocols and preserve equivalent lifecycle capabilities and VIA user functions.

changes.title: Push status to query status
changes.rationale: TASK-T01 already freezes Event-first + Query Reconciliation with provider capability profiles. Switching an Agent from push to query-only selects an existing path/cadence profile rather than changing C/I/S/D definitions.
changes.preservation: Task correlation, timestamp honesty and completion visibility must remain correct under query fallback.

changes.title: Execution identity and follow-up contract change
changes.rationale: The baseline intentionally contains both P-style single-run and Q-style context+run/new-run continuation native contracts. This reviewed change is already inside the frozen variation envelope; provider binding selects the existing shape.
changes.preservation: Maintain VIA Task identity, exact run correlation, follow-up continuity and duplicate-execution prevention.

changes.title: Capability contract restructuring
changes.rationale: Splitting capabilities and changing required-field/version/lifecycle declaration changes registry interpretation and the capability snapshot schema. Semantic selection still consumes capability data generically.
changes.preservation: Existing document work must map to the correct new capability/inputs while old/new declarations can coexist during the scenario.

changes.title: Agent authentication contract change
changes.rationale: Moving from fixed credentials to user-scoped expiring/refreshable authorization changes native auth behavior and the policy decision contract that intersects current Agent authorization with user scope. Token values themselves are not separate elements.
changes.preservation: Refresh, expiry and denial must remain bound to the correct user, Task, Context scope and consent.

changes.title: Question/approval response lifecycle change
changes.rationale: Question-ID-specific answer submission/resume changes native lifecycle semantics. A absorbs it in edge normalization; B extends the typed variation and Core handler. Existing G2-S-PENDING already stores question/approval identity and answer state.
changes.preservation: Answers must bind to the correct pending question, submission confirmation and resume state without replaying completed answers.

changes.title: Result artifact delivery contract change
changes.rationale: Result-list/reference representation changes native lifecycle meaning. A normalizes the representation at the edge; B exposes the typed artifact variant to its Core handler. User-facing result composition remains on the existing canonical result path.
changes.preservation: Preserve actual result artifacts, Voice/Text result delivery and later result references; arrival is not confused with detail retrieval.

changes.title: Context Source provider replacement
changes.rationale: Calendar provider native API/identity/field mapping changes transport plus ContextBroker provider adaptation while the canonical scoped Context contract remains stable.
changes.preservation: Preserve event time, participant/source identity, access scope and referent binding.

changes.title: Add document format
changes.rationale: DOCX body/table extraction extends ContextBroker source-format handling. It does not introduce a new product responsibility or change the canonical Context contract.
changes.preservation: Keep existing formats and read-only semantics while preserving document/object identity for the new format.

changes.title: Screen integration contract change
changes.rationale: Windows screen/object-handle/coordinate/selection API variation is adapted by Capture; downstream Turn/Context semantics remain stable.
changes.preservation: Preserve screen/document/location identity for Select-then-Speak, Speak-while-Pointing and correction.

changes.title: Memory record format expansion
changes.rationale: Adding record version, modification time and user-registration provenance changes the Memory state schema, MemoryService read/write/migration behavior and repository migration handling.
changes.preservation: Existing memory content, consent boundary, correction/deletion and tombstone effects must survive migration.

changes.title: Add same-kind Context Source
changes.rationale: Keeping source A while adding source B requires provider-specific native connection support and ContextBroker source-identity/scope selection. No new Context product responsibility is introduced.
changes.preservation: Distinguish source identity and permissions while preserving existing source A behavior; no new cross-provider merge feature is assumed.

changes.title: Conversation and Task record format migration
changes.rationale: The reviewed V1→V2 storage change explicitly covers Conversation/Request/Task/Agent-execution relationships. Their persistent schemas and repository migration behavior change; Task-writer or Agent-boundary behavior does not change when the Repository contract remains stable.
changes.preservation: Preserve relationships, deletion effects, running work, recovery and duplicate-action prevention after planned migration; failure must leave the old records recoverable.
